rejected: I inspect the smear, keep the notebook safely, and brush the dust from my sleeve.
source_parent_response: The paper is old, probably from the library. I rub my thumb along the edge, then pocket the rusting key. “No,” I say, then turn it over. “No.” I keep the paper instead of tearing it. “No, I keep it.” I pocket the rusting key and keep the rusting key. The paper is proof, but the evidence is proof only.
why_chosen: Retains tactile evidence-gathering and selective preservation rather than generic cleanliness.
